This webpage is very misleading. I just got a Roku 3. Many of the "Free" channels are not free. What they mean by a "Free" channel is Roku does not charge you but the content provider does. If you subscribe to a channel, like the History channel, you can enter a cable subscribe code to get the content from Roku at no additional charge.

  • PBS. This was the whole reason I got a Roku 3. Not all content is free. Some content directs you to pay websites like Netflix or Amazon.
  • FoxNews. Only trailers and clips are free. Almost no free full broadcasts or shows.
